## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD= scripts/test-ralph.sh` | Full `ralph.sh` red/green suite (mock `claude`/`codex` on PATH, mktemp sandbox) |
| `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD= scripts/test-ralph.sh <case>` | Run 1 test case |
| `scripts/check-shell.sh` | `bash -n` on every `scripts/*.sh` + `shellcheck -x` when installed |
| `scripts/check-init-drift.sh` | Detect drift of shared rules duplicated across `commands/init.md` and `commands/init/*.md` |

- Build: none (no package manager, no Makefile).
- Coverage: none.
- CI: none — run checks locally.
- Tests cover `scripts/ralph.sh` only; other scripts and markdown get static checks only.

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

- Shell scripts start with `#!/usr/bin/env bash` and target Bash 4+ (`declare -A` in `scripts/ralph.sh`, `scripts/ralph-watch.sh`).
- Every `scripts/*.sh` must pass `bash -n` — enforced by `scripts/check-shell.sh`.
- Shell code must pass `shellcheck -x` when shellcheck is installed — enforced by `scripts/check-shell.sh` (skipped when absent).
- Shared rules duplicated inline in `commands/init.md` and `commands/init/*.md` must stay in sync — enforced by anchors in `scripts/check-init-drift.sh`.
- Slash commands in `commands/*.md` are thin routers; heavy work lives in `agents/*.md` subagents (markdown + frontmatter).
- Plugin commands are namespaced `/bc-harness:*`; manifest in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
- `ralph.sh` runtime state lives in `.phases/` (gitignored); never commit it.
- `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/` are gitignored; only `AGENTS.md` of the generated tree is tracked.
- Test changes to `ralph.sh` must be able to go red: point `RALPH_BIN` at a patched copy to prove it.
- Full guidelines: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Small `scripts/ralph.sh` tweak made as a side step: run `bash -n` and at most 1 case (`scripts/test-ralph.sh <case>`), not the full ~770-assert suite.
- Run `scripts/check-shell.sh` after any edit under `scripts/`.
- Run `scripts/check-init-drift.sh` after any edit to `commands/init.md` or `commands/init/*.md`.

### Never in this repository

- Never run `scripts/ralph.sh` or `scripts/test-ralph.sh` without `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD=` (or `env -u RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD`) — the inherited `~/.bashrc` export fires Telegram notifications (`.claude/rules/conventions.md`).
- Never leave a `scripts/*.sh` failing `bash -n` (`scripts/check-shell.sh`).
- Never hand-edit `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or `docs/agents/*.md` — regenerate via `/bc-harness:ai-context`.

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prereqs: Bash 4+, git, `claude` and/or `codex` CLI, jq (or python3), curl, timeout, tput/stty; shellcheck optional.

Install plugin (inside Claude Code):

```sh
/plugin install bc-harness
```

Install engine CLIs:

```sh
npm install -g @openai/codex
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
```

Configure Telegram notifier (optional):

```sh
scripts/notify-telegram.sh --setup
scripts/notify-telegram.sh --test
```

| Symptom | Check |
|---|---|
| `ralph.sh` refuses to start | Git tree must be clean (preflight) |
| Unexpected Telegram messages during dev runs | Prefix with `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD=` |
| `ralph.sh` aborts on usage limit | Weekly limit aborts; short limits wait/retry (`RALPH_MAX_LIMIT_WAITS`, `RALPH_LIMIT_WAIT_DEFAULT`, `RALPH_WEEKLY_THRESHOLD`) |
| `sail-guard.sh` blocks nothing | Needs jq or python3; fails open without both |
| `check-shell.sh` prints shellcheck skipped | Install shellcheck (`apt install shellcheck`) |
| Telegram notifier silent | `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` / `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` in env or `~/.config/ralph-notify/telegram.env` |

Key env vars: `RALPH_TEST_CMD`, `RALPH_VERIFY`, `RALPH_VERIFY_MODEL` (default `sonnet`), `RALPH_MAX_CYCLES`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_TIMEOUT`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_ENV_FILE`. Test-only: `RALPH_BIN`, `MOCK_SCENARIO`.
